description: On the bed in front of the hands are three large toy blocks: a blue rectangular block, a small yellow block, and a small red piece. The left hand reaches forward toward the red piece while the right hand moves toward the blue block; the right hand steadies the blue block as it’s set onto the yellow block, then the left hand lifts the red piece and presses it down onto the top of the blue block before both hands pull back, leaving the stacked build standing.
